IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Sunday 1 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots becoming northwesterly below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Monday 2 November
Winds: North to northwesterly below 10 knots tending east to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the early afternoon then tending south to southeasterly in the late afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Tuesday 3 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming south to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the early afternoon then turning west to southwesterly below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Wednesday 4 November
Winds: North to northwesterly below 10 knots tending west to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots during the day.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 90% chance of showers.

Thursday 5 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots tending northwesterly during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
IDT12420.synoptic: A weak ridge of high pressure moved across to the north of Tasmania on Sunday. A low pressure system is forecast to move across Victoria during Monday, crossing Bass Strait, before moving over the Tasman Sea on Tuesday. A cold front is expected to move across Tasmania from the west on Wednesday followed by a more significant cold front later Friday.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Sunday 1 November
Winds: Westerly 15 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots inshore in the late afternoon.
Seas: 1.5 to 2 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 1 to 1.5 metres inshore, increasing to 2 metres offshore.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Monday 2 November
Winds: Westerly 15 to 20 knots becoming variable about 10 knots in the evening.
Seas: 1 to 2 metres, decreasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning, then decreasing below 1 metre around midday.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres, increasing to 3 to 4 metres during the morning.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 50% chance of showers.

Tuesday 3 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming southeast to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then becoming variable about 10 knots in the early afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 50% chance of showers.

Wednesday 4 November
Winds: North to northwesterly 10 to 15 knots turning west to southwesterly 15 to 25 knots during the afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the afternoon or evening.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Northeasterly around 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers, with possible small hail in the afternoon and evening.
